newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Britain asks Bangladesh for more economic reforms.
newsitem.headline: Britain asks Bangladesh for more economic reforms.

text.p: Britain said on Tuesday it was keen to increase investment in Bangladesh but said Dhaka needed to maintain political stability, introduce further economic reforms and reduce red tape.

"Bangladesh must continue the progress of liberalisation of the reform process if it wants to secure further foreign direct investment," Sir Martin Laing, chairman of the British Overseas Trade Board, told a news conference at the end of a three-day visit.
Laing, who headed a six-member British business delegation, met Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and held talks with government officials and business leaders.

"The UK stressed the need for continuous political stability, the need for transparency in the formulation of policy and in consideration of projects and...speed in decision making and reduction of bureaucracy," he said
Laing said the investment climate in Bangladesh had improved recently.

He said Bangladesh's trade ties with Britain had also shown an upswing after British firm Cairn Energy Plc signed a deal with state-owned Petrobangla for gas exploration during a recent visit to Dhaka by Prime Minister John Major.
